summary: SOL Strategies Inc. filed a 6-K announcing the closed acquisition of HoudiniSwap LLC, a privacy-focused cross-chain swap aggregator, for a total purchase price of USD $18 million. Consideration comprised USD $7mm cash at closing, USD $4mm in common shares (2,812,301 shares issued based on 90-day VWAP), plus USD $5.75mm cash due December 1, 2026, and a USD $1.25mm indemnity holdback over 18 months. A two-year earn-out up to USD $10mm is tied to Adjusted EBITDA above a $2.5mm annual threshold. The cash component was financed via decentralized finance protocols on Solana without selling treasury SOL. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners advised SOL Strategies. Watch for integration synergies and earn-out performance milestones.
